scripts.mpeg30: ffmpeg -y -f image2 -framerate 30 -i frames/frame%07d.png -pix_fmt yuv420p video-bad-timing.mp4 && npm run offset-timing-mpeg
scripts.mpeg60: ffmpeg -y -f image2 -framerate 60 -i frames/frame%07d.png -i test-data/Mixdown/Mixdown.wav -pix_fmt yuv420p video-bad-timing.mp4 && npm run offset-timing-mpeg
scripts.mov30: ffmpeg -y -f image2 -framerate 30 -i frames/frame%07d.png -pix_fmt yuv420p video.mov && npm run offset-timing-mov
scripts.mov60: ffmpeg -y -f image2 -framerate 60 -i frames/frame%07d.png -pix_fmt yuv420p video.mov && npm run offset-timing-mov
